lines.beaver_en: What kind of place is today's survey area?
lines.en: It's a coast near a forest thick with trees.
The grass was so overgrown it was hard to walk.

lines.beaver_en: That must have been tough. What animals did you see in the forest?
lines.en: Penguins were building nests in the forest.

lines.beaver_en: It's breeding season now, so it's dangerous.
lines.en: Yes, animals are always sensitive in breeding season.

lines.beaver_en: Which penguins were the most sensitive?
lines.en: The males shouted while guarding the nests.
Right. They naturally get startled when people come.

lines.beaver_en: What about the plants? Were there sprouts?
lines.learner: 네, 비가 와서 새싹이 많이 텄어요.
lines.en: Yes, it rained, so lots of sprouts came up.
lines.roman: ne, biga waseo saessagi mani teosseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Weren't there a lot of bugs too?
lines.en: Yes, there were tons of mosquitoes.

lines.beaver_en: When it's humid and warm, there are always many bugs.
lines.en: Yes, next time I'll bring insect protection gear.

lines.beaver_en: Good. Let's start the survey in earnest tomorrow.
lines.en: Okay, I'll organize the report and give it to you.
